name: python-micromamba
description: Fast, lightweight conda-compatible package manager for Python environments

conda.description: Cross-platform package manager for Python and R ecosystems, fully self-contained executable
conda.usage:
conda create -n myenv python=3.11
conda install numpy pandas scipy
conda list
conda env list
conda activate myenv
conda deactivate
conda update --all
conda remove package-name

micromamba.description: Fast, lightweight conda-compatible package manager with minimal dependencies
micromamba.usage:
micromamba create -n myenv python=3.11
micromamba install -n myenv numpy pandas
micromamba activate myenv
micromamba list
micromamba info
micromamba env list
micromamba update --all
micromamba clean --all
